content: {"like":["Values high‑definition, widescreen cinematic experiences with grand storytelling and immersive audio; prefers a friendly, knowledgeable host and authentic musical performances; enjoys educational content and varied musical genres; appreciates vivid, high‑contrast visuals and creative camera work; seeks realistic, atmospheric settings such as aquariums or weather simulations."],"dislike":["Dislikes narrow aspect ratios and any visual or audio quality that feels low‑resolution or unpolished; rejects poorly executed storytelling, acting, or cinematography; avoids repetitive or gimmicky elements; dislikes content that feels gratuitous or lacking substance; is critical of any technical shortcomings in restoration or transfer quality."]}
